about_the_game:
Game Duration

The game is divided into ten chapters (10 days), with a total playtime of approximately 4 to 8 hours.

Game Genre

This is a text-based narrative game with life simulation elements. Players take on the role of a space radio DJ, interacting with NPCs by playing music to connect with them and advance the storyline.

Gameplay

Listen to the stories of radio listeners and select different tracks for them based on their musical tastes and preferences.

Each listener has unique tastes. Players must choose songs that match their emotional state, rhythm, and harmonic preferences.

Different musical styles will influence the outcomes of both the listeners' and the protagonist’s stories.

Background Story

With the advancement of interstellar jump technology, all intelligent life forms across the universe have long achieved the freedom and convenience of interstellar travel. Frequent communication and trade between different civilizations have given birth to a vibrant and yet absurd universe.

On December 22, 2999, the Dutaffians, having spent a fortune to acquire ownership of Earth from humans, are about to fully take over the blue planet and begin reverting it to a primitive state. Facing a world soon to be stripped of all human-made technology, DJ Z’s space radio station is also forced to shut down.

Characters in the Game

As Z's radio station counts down its final 10 days, a diverse cast of listeners floods into the livestream — interstellar pirates, space morticians, cosmic racers, star poets, bounty hunters, galactic scavengers, and more. Through music, they share bizarre tales from the universe... and reveal their own personal stories.
